data.name: Itminan
data.gender_notes: Itminan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Itminan is an Arabic name derived from the Arabic word ‘itmāna’ which means ‘to fear Allah’. It is a name that embodies the spirit of reverence and obedience towards the Almighty. The name is rooted in Islamic teachings and emphasizes the importance of living a God-conscious life. The name Itminan carries the meaning “Fear of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Itminan usually hope their child will grow to embody fear of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the fear of Allah, instilling a deep sense of reverence and obedience.
data.etymology: Itminan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fear of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Itminan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: إطمئنان
in_arabic.meaning: هو الإطمئنان إلى الله، وعدم الخوف منه
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإطمئنان هو حالة من الرضا والطمأنينة التي تنتجان عن الإيمان بالله ووحدانيته، وعدم الخوف منه ورسائله، بل هو الإيمان بالله ورسالته، والاعiance عليه في كل حال، وهو من أسماء الخير والبركة في الإسلام، ويعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويذكر في القرآن الكريم، وعادة ما يختار المسلمون أسماء الله الحسنى للولدان لتعليمهم الأسماء الحسنى، وتعريفهم بجمال الله، والإطمئنان يعتبر من أسماء الخير التي تعكس شخصيته الخيرة، ويخلع الشعوب المسلمة عليه أسماء الحب والمودة
